summary: REQ-1008 asks for TaskFlow Pro (Project Management, $8,000/yr, 15 users) for Marketing. The catalog already has TaskFlow (SW003) with the same vendor, product name and category. It is Approved, Company-wide, has 180 licensed seats and covers the requester's department. evaluate_policy flags existing_tool_overlap, requires Department Head and Procurement approval and gives the baseline label 'Review existing tool before new purchase'. The request is within budget, and the vendor is approved with a low risk rating. The request fields contain no instruction-like text.
concerns: Existing approved company-wide TaskFlow (SW003, 180 seats, Company-wide) already covers the requester's department (covers_requester_department: true), and the justification ('Marketing wants a task tracker for campaign launches') names no gap the existing tool cannot meet.
PO-2501 (2026-06-22, Operations, $36,000, Approved, 'Company-wide agreement') shows an existing company-wide TaskFlow agreement, so the $8,000 request may duplicate spend.
The request names the product 'TaskFlow Pro' while the catalog lists 'TaskFlow'. The evidence does not show whether Pro is a separate tier or what extra capability it adds.
Marketing has $15,000 available of the $180,000 software budget ($165,000 committed). The $8,000 fits (within_budget: true, shortfall_usd 0.0) but would use more than half of the remaining headroom.

get_vendor_risk reports processes_personal_data: true for TaskFlow. The request lists only internal_marketing data, and evaluate_policy returned no data_classes, so no additional data class is inferred from the free text.
